name: Othniel
overview: Othniel, the son of Kenaz and nephew of Caleb, is recognized in Scripture as a courageous leader who conquered Kirjath-sepher, fulfilling Caleb's promise of giving his daughter Achsah in marriage to the one who would take the city. This union not only secured a blessing of land but also the gift of springs of water, symbolizing God's provision and favor. Othniel's role extends beyond conquest, as he becomes a deliverer and judge of Israel, guiding the nation in times of need and establishing a legacy through his descendants.
